Interesting how so many in the GOP cannot come out and clearly say "I do not think there should be a fund that pays people convicted of violence against police officers on Jan. 6 with American tax dollars."

Only a handful have even acknowledged it.

"stupid on stilts"
"tyranny"
"absurd"

That's what Republican Senator Thom Tillis calls the new Trump DOJ $1.8B slush fund. 

Now what’s stopping the rest of the GOP?
Trump stole money from your Medicaid for these freaks to cash out, and any elected representative who isn't loudly opposed to his slush fund is helping him rob you.
Trump is using your tax dollars to give government handouts to friends of his who don’t like being held accountable for their crimes. Had enough yet?
Funding for everything around you is being cut daily but this administration, but somehow Trump wants you to be OK with him stealing your tax dollars to pay his January 6 insurrectionists.
